name: routavio
description: Door-to-door routes and observed flight fares and the cheapest destinations from a city across Europe and Turkiye, with the date each price was checked.

interface.longDescription: Door-to-door routes and observed flight fares and the cheapest destinations from a city across Europe and Turkiye, with the date each price was checked. Shows train, bus, ferry and flight options with operators, and flight fare cards sorted by price with airline logos.
defaultPrompt: How do I get from Berlin to Prague?
Cheapest flights from Istanbul to London
capabilities: Find door-to-door routes between two cities
Show plane, train, bus and ferry legs with operators and travel time
Show the lowest observed one-way flight fares with the day each was checked
Show the cheapest observed destinations from a city
